target: KSW kg: combined kitchen and serving waste; not pure unserved surplus
purpose: Separate real-data forecasting benchmark; not a transfer test of full synthetic model
split: first 20 days history, next 80 train, next 25 validation, final 30 test
prediction_timing: before service, menu/calendar and strictly preceding measured days only
test_history_policy: one-day-ahead rolling origin; prior test-day observations available the next measured day; no model refit
intervention: last 20 of the 30 test days have a reported art intervention
selection: minimum validation MAE separately for RF and LightGBM; test not used to choose models
missing_target_policy: One missing KSW on 2024-09-02, in history warmup. Never fabricate a target. Rolling histories skip missing values; remaining feature gaps use training median imputation.
